notes: Terminal capture is speaker-safe by default. Local TTS echo cannot start a recursive turn. After drain, speech-level loopback stays ignored until a quiet frame. s or space cuts the current turn. SLEEPTALK_TERMINAL_FULL_DUPLEX=1 restores spoken barge-in. Commit uses UtteranceAssembler, decide_endpoint on live partials, and Smart Turn. Streaming STT gets at most 200 ms of trailing hush. No Silero, fragment hold, or user-driven resume. Gold pin 4b3efe5 for the speaker-safe loop.
